maintenance.title: Service under maintenance
maintenance.text: The service is under maintenance: new transfers and invitations are suspended for a while. Downloads remain available.

error.title: The page could not be loaded

email.title: Send files
email.intro: Enter your email address. A verification code will be sent to it the first time.
email.invitationIntro: {invitedBy} invited you to send files. A verification code will be sent to your email address.
email.label: Your email address
email.invitationHint: The address the invitation was sent to.
email.notAllowed: Deposits are only possible from the internal network with an address of the organisation. To send files from outside, ask an internal user to invite you.
email.invitationGone: This invitation has expired or is no longer valid. Ask the person who invited you for a new invitation.
email.remoteHint: Working outside the organisation’s network? If your address is already verified, a verification code is asked at each deposit.
email.dropLinkIntro: To send files to "{label}", enter your e-mail address. A verification code will be sent to it at every deposit.
email.dropLinkGone: This drop link is no longer valid. Ask the person who gave it to you for a new one.

code.title: Enter the verification code
code.intro: A 6-digit code has been sent to {email}. Check your inbox, and your spam folder if needed.
code.label: Verification code
code.format: The code is made of 6 digits.
code.exhausted: The code has expired or too many wrong codes were entered. Ask for a new code.
code.resent: A new code has been sent.

session.invite: Invite someone to send you files
session.expired: Your session has expired. Identify yourself again to continue.
session.remote: You are depositing from outside: a verification code is asked at each deposit, and invitations are not available.

form.title: New transfer

recipients.label: Recipients
recipients.hint: One or more email addresses, separated by commas or line breaks.
recipients.external: The files will be sent to {invitedBy}, who invited you.
recipients.domainRefused: This service does not allow sending to the domain of this address.
recipients.optionalHint: Optional for a link-only transfer: no mail is sent to these addresses.

message.label: Message
message.hint: Optional. Sent to the recipients with the link.

forcedByLink.one: The files stay available {count} day, a duration set by this drop link.
forcedByLink.other: The files stay available {count} days, a duration set by this drop link.

password.label: Password
password.hint: Optional. The recipients will need it to download the files: share it through another channel (phone, text message), never in the same email.
password.requiredHint: Required by the chosen confidentiality level. The recipients will need it to download the files: share it through another channel (phone, text message), never in the same email.
password.requiredByLevel: The chosen confidentiality level requires a password.

deleteAfterFirstDownload.label: Delete the transfer after the first download
deleteAfterFirstDownload.hint: The files are deleted as soon as one recipient has downloaded them.
deleteAfterFirstDownload.forced: Required by the chosen confidentiality level.

files.label: Files to send
files.hint: Up to {max} in total and {count} files per transfer.
files.tooMany: A transfer can contain at most {max} files.
files.tooLarge: The files exceed the maximum size of a transfer. Remove some files.

invalidNames.one: {count} file name is not accepted: rename the file and add it again.
invalidNames.other: {count} file names are not accepted: rename the files and add them again.

level.hint: The level sets rules for this transfer (duration, password, recipients…).
level.none: No confidentiality level is currently available for you, so no transfer can be sent. Contact your administrator.

maxDownloads.label: Maximum number of downloads
maxDownloads.hint: Optional, from 1 to {max}. Once reached, the transfer can no longer be downloaded and is deleted.
maxDownloads.invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and {max}, or leave the field empty.
maxDownloads.exceeded: The chosen confidentiality level allows at most {max} downloads.

rules.required: The chosen confidentiality level requires this field.
rules.not-allowed: The chosen confidentiality level does not allow this value.
rules.internal-only: The chosen confidentiality level only allows recipients of the organisation.
rules.max-exceeded: This value is above the maximum allowed by the chosen confidentiality level.

recipientVerification.label: Recipients must verify their address by code
recipientVerification.hint: Each recipient receives a personal link and must enter a code sent to their address before downloading. A forwarded link cannot be used.
recipientVerification.forced: Required by the chosen confidentiality level.
recipientVerification.requiredByLevel: The chosen confidentiality level requires the recipients to verify their address.
recipientVerification.incompatibleLinkOnly: Not available for a link-only transfer.

form.abuseBlocked: This transfer exceeds a limit set by the organisation (volume, number of transfers or recipients): it is refused. Try again later or contact the administrator.

linkOnly.label: Link only (no e-mail to the recipients)
linkOnly.hint: No mail is sent: the link is shown to you once at the end of the upload and you pass it on yourself.
linkOnly.blockedByVerification: Not available: the chosen confidentiality level requires recipient verification.

upload.cancelled: The transfer has been cancelled. You can change it and send it again.
upload.cancelFailed: The transfer could not be cancelled on the server. Its incomplete files will be deleted automatically when the upload time limit expires.
upload.leaveConfirm: A transfer is being sent. Leaving this page will interrupt it. Leave anyway?

done.title: Transfer sent
done.passwordNote: The transfer is protected: remember to send the password to the recipients through another channel.
done.deleteAfterFirstDownloadNote: The transfer will be deleted after the first download.

warning.infected: This file contained a threat: it was deleted and will not be delivered.
warning.notScanned: This file could not be analysed by the antivirus: it is delivered and the recipients are told so.
warning.scanError: This file could not be analysed: it is withheld and will not be delivered.

linkOnly.title: Download link
linkOnly.intro: No mail was sent to the recipients. Pass this link on to them yourself.
linkOnly.shownOnce: This link is shown only once: copy it now.
linkOnly.label: Download link
linkOnly.missing: The link could not be shown. You can get a new one from "My transfers"; the old one will then stop working.

resume.ready: All the files needed are selected.

e2e.label: Encrypt end to end in my browser
e2e.hint: The files, their names and the message are encrypted in your browser before being sent: the server cannot read them. They are not analysed by the antivirus. At the end you get a decryption key: send it to the recipients through another channel (phone, text message), never in the same email. Without it, the files cannot be opened.
e2e.requiredHint: Required by your organisation for this transfer. The files, their names and the message are encrypted in your browser and are not analysed by the antivirus. At the end you get a decryption key to send to the recipients through another channel.
e2e.required: This transfer must be encrypted end to end.
e2e.forbidden: End-to-end encryption is not allowed for this transfer.
e2e.unsupported: This browser cannot encrypt the files (a secure connection and a recent browser are needed). Use another browser.
e2e.prepareFailed: The files could not be prepared for encryption. Check that they are still available, then try again.
e2e.resumeChanged: A selected file is not exactly the one of the interrupted transfer (its content changed). For your security this transfer cannot be resumed: start a new transfer.
e2e.notScanned: Encrypted end to end: the antivirus cannot analyse this file.
e2e.uploadNote: The files are encrypted in your browser as they are sent.

preparing.title: Preparing the encryption
preparing.text: Your browser reads each file once to compute its fingerprint before encrypting it. The files do not leave your computer during this step.
preparing.cancelled: The preparation was cancelled. You can change the transfer and send it again.
preparing.done: Preparation complete, the transfer is being created.
preparing.resumeText: Your browser reads each file again to check that it is exactly the one selected before the interruption. The files do not leave your computer during this step.
preparing.resumeCancelled: The check was cancelled. Select the files again to resume the upload.

done.title: Decryption key
done.intro: The files are encrypted end to end. The recipients need this key to open them: send it to them through another channel than the download link (phone, text message).
done.shownOnce: This key is shown only once and is not kept anywhere: copy it now. Without it, the files cannot be opened, even by the administrators.
done.label: Decryption key
done.linkNote: This link contains the decryption key: anyone who has it can open the files.
done.encryptionNote: End to end: the server cannot read the files, their names or the message.
